com.github.pbednarcik.flexthemes FlexThemes Peter Bednarčík @VERSION@

FlexThemes is the collection of Visual Studio-inspired themes JetBrains tools have always been missing: calm colors, clear panel edges and easy-to-read code.

Nine light and dark appearances and eight editor schemes for Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand and PyCharm: Morning Mist, Lavender Mist Gold, Indigo and Blue, Blue Mist, Periwinkle Islands, Graphite, Periwinkle Night and Abyss, plus the alternative Lavender Mist Purple editor scheme.

Code colours are shared across C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python, and every text colour is checked for contrast. Requires JetBrains IDEs 2026.2 or later with the Islands UI.

If you installed any of the single-family theme plugins, uninstall them first; they register the same themes.

First public release: nine light and dark appearances and eight editor schemes for Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand and PyCharm with the Islands UI.

  • Visual Studio-inspired panel separation, focus cues and editor gutters, each theme with its own palette.
  • Shared language colours for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python, checked against the installed IDEs' own declarations.
  • Every text colour is checked for contrast when the bundle is built, and every appearance is checked in native screenshots of all four IDEs.

Uninstall the corresponding standalone theme plugins before installing the bundle.
